{
  "groups": [
    {
      "member_ids": ["8fb0b7194c5c77ae70b0", "d8fe58d37affbbc9e36b", "4d14c4d540923ce76942", "e283b43083366109d320"],
      "operation": "Unpack a typed object member and report its error through an unpack error destination.",
      "condition": "A string format selects a non-string object member.",
      "capability": "json_unpack_ex can report the member key in the wrong-type diagnostic.",
      "consequence": "The keyed diagnostic is unavailable through the entry's generic o format and json_unpack call.",
      "equivalence_reason": "All four target the same new key-bearing diagnostic for a typed member mismatch."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["7bd74aa7add4aa6f6cd1", "43f494b9a55032c1b6b8", "0aad7c0daf075ad70445"],
      "operation": "Unpack an object member with a string value format.",
      "condition": "The selected member is not a string.",
      "capability": "The string format rejects the member's type; {s?o} selects generic o instead.",
      "consequence": "The wrong-type member is not rejected by string validation.",
      "equivalence_reason": "These target the same object-member type check, independent of diagnostic wording."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["7399897e3fca616a5e5c"],
      "operation": "Unpack an array element with i.",
      "condition": "The selected element is not an integer.",
      "capability": "i rejects the element's type; [o!] selects generic o instead.",
      "consequence": "The non-integer element is not rejected by integer validation.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Its array element and integer condition differ from the other typed-format claims."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["19b8670cbfad4079c89e", "3a5b48c635da727b3b55"],
      "operation": "Unpack a required object member.",
      "condition": "The object lacks that member.",
      "capability": "Object unpacking rejects a missing required member; ? makes data optional.",
      "consequence": "The missing data member is not rejected as required.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Both target the same missing-member check and optional-marker constraint."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["d9c2544056b39c3c152e", "2a74e86bb65461f97ac0", "6ab435b16047aaeb829a"],
      "operation": "Strictly unpack an object.",
      "condition": "The object contains a member unconsumed by the format.",
      "capability": "An object ! marker or strict unpack flag enables rejection; {s?o} and json_unpack do not enable it.",
      "consequence": "The extra object member is not rejected by strict object validation.",
      "equivalence_reason": "All three target strict rejection of unconsumed object members."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["70a7aa285e91b2bbba24", "d35578abe5b06da8c6ef"],
      "operation": "Extract or validate a scalar through a typed unpack format.",
      "condition": "A scalar value is selected with a typed format.",
      "capability": "Formats s, i, I, b, f, F, and n select typed scalar behavior; the entry selects o.",
      "consequence": "Typed scalar extraction or validation is not reached.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Both describe the same general typed-scalar dispatch gap."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["17ef95db0573e1aab4fa", "f5c108989b64f242ad6f"],
      "operation": "Recursively unpack a nested object or array.",
      "condition": "A selected member or element contains a nested structure.",
      "capability": "Nested object or array formats descend into the value; o returns the value without descending.",
      "consequence": "Recursive unpacking of the nested value is not reached.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Both target recursive format dispatch for nested values."
    },
    {
      "member_ids": ["147c32844bc0c549cd11", "d6239e681becd913b6ab"],
      "operation": "Extract a JSON value with the O unpack format.",
      "condition": "A valid selected value is unpacked with O.",
      "capability": "O acquires a retained reference that must be released; the entry selects borrowed o.",
      "consequence": "Retained-reference extraction and its ownership behavior are not reached.",
      "equivalence_reason": "Both target the same O-format reference ownership contract."
    }
  ]
}
